scope: Targeted post-correction checks of both eastern bridge landings and the northern water-facing edge; full bridge traversals are prior-build evidence only.

checks.name: The exact source and editor show seven reshaped biomes, the organic lagoon, two channels and exactly two bridges
Water polygons are selectable and their vertices use the existing complete Undo/Redo history
Dragging an island vertex updates the visible shoreline immediately even when the island contains water holes
Ordinary object placement and the grass brush cannot create placements inside the lagoon
JSON save/open preserves water polygons exactly, while older documents without waterAreas remain readable
Exported standalone HTML reopens the exact lagoon geometry and retains the water-area controls

previousFullTraversal.note: Earlier full crossings established the fixture routes; they were not repeated on this corrected build.

checks.name: north landing supports ordinary entry and off-center exit without water entry, teleport or abrupt height steps
south landing supports ordinary entry and off-center exit without water entry, teleport or abrupt height steps
The corrected runtime still blocks walking off the northern bridge into the channel

limits: Chromium software WebGL. Player state is read only; fixture starts use ordinary JSON imports and movement uses WASD. No device-performance claim.
